name: growing_deposits_inflated_target_midplan_withdrawal_topup
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local retirement plan. A saver starts with zero savings and makes end-of-year deposits for {N} years. The first deposit, at the end of year 1, is {D} USD; each later deposit is {G} percent larger than the previous year's deposit. The balance earns {R} percent per year, credited at each year end before that year's deposit is added. At the end of year {K}, immediately after that year's deposit, the saver withdraws {W} USD once; the remaining balance keeps compounding. The retirement target is {T} USD in today's purchasing power and is inflated at {I} percent per year compounded over all {N} years. Shortfall is the larger of the inflated target minus the projected end-of-year-{N} balance and zero. To close any shortfall, the saver would add a level extra deposit at the end of each year from the year after the withdrawal year through year {N} inclusive, earning the same {R} percent return. The top-up factor is the sum of the end-of-year-{N} compounded values of one USD deposited at each of those year ends. The required extra annual deposit equals shortfall divided by the top-up factor and is zero when there is no shortfall. Report the projected balance, inflated target, shortfall and top-up factor.

slots.description: Report projected balance at end of final plan year after withdrawal.
Report retirement target inflated over the full plan horizon.
Report nonnegative shortfall of projected balance versus inflated target.
Report compounded value sum of one USD deposited each top-up year end.

program:
def solve():
    D = Fraction(P["D"])
    g = Fraction(P["G"]) / 100
    r = Fraction(P["R"]) / 100
    N = int(P["N"])
    K = int(P["K"])
    W = Fraction(P["W"])
    T = Fraction(P["T"])
    i = Fraction(P["I"]) / 100
    if K >= N:
        raise ValueError("withdrawal year must precede final plan year")
    bal = Fraction(0)
    for t in range(1, N + 1):
        bal = bal * (1 + r) + D * (1 + g) ** (t - 1)
        if t == K:
            if bal < W:
                raise ValueError("withdrawal exceeds balance")
            bal = bal - W
    target = T * (1 + i) ** N
    shortfall = max(target - bal, Fraction(0))
    factor = Fraction(0)
    for j in range(N - K):
        factor = factor + (1 + r) ** j
    extra = shortfall / factor
    return {
        "final": extra,
        "projected_balance_usd": bal,
        "inflated_target_usd": target,
        "shortfall_usd": shortfall,
        "topup_factor": factor,
    }
